description: Agent Action Receipts API (verify): Issue and verify tamper-evident signed audit receipts for AI agent actions (integrity proof only). (Endpoint: POST /v1/agent-action-receipts/verify)

chain.description: Ordered array of 1 to 200 signed receipt tokens to verify signatures and prev_hash chain continuity.

expected_input.description: Optional expected action_input value; canonicalized and hashed to verify against the first receipt's input_sha256.

expected_output.description: Optional expected action_output value; canonicalized and hashed to verify against the first receipt's output_sha256.

jwks.description: Optional JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) containing public keys for verifying asymmetric EdDSA or ES256 receipts.

keys.description: Array of up to 100 public JWK entries matched by kid for EdDSA (Ed25519) or ES256 (P-256) verification.
Map of key ID (kid) to HMAC signing secret for verifying HS256 receipts across rotated keys.

now_epoch.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in seconds used as the reference clock for expiration checks.

receipt_token.description: Single compact signed receipt token to verify (required unless 'chain' is provided).

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 verification secret (or pass via X-Tinplate-Signing-Secret header when not using keys or jwks).

name: tinplate_agent_action_receipts_verify
